svg.title: A 1104-cap in nine dimensions: exact coordinate atlas
svg.desc: Three vertically stacked panels with 512, 80, 512 dots. Block columns encode z1,z2; block rows encode z3,z4. Within a block, dot columns encode v1,v2 and dot rows v3,v4. All pairs use lexicographic order -1,0,1 increasing rightwards and upwards.

g.text: One dot = one point · common coordinates in every panel
Blocks: columns (z₁,z₂), rows (z₃,z₄). Dots within each block: columns (v₁,v₂), rows (v₃,v₄).
Pairs run in lexicographic order −1, 0, 1, increasing rightwards and upwards.
Straight alignments in this encoding need not be lines over F₃.
